svg.title: Point, axial: SF 1.313
svg.desc: Point, axial. 150 N along the tip bisector on the last 0.75 mm, read from 1 to 10 mm. Solid SF 1.313, required 1.2.
svg.text: 150 N along the tip bisector on the last 0.75 mm, read from 1 to 10 mm
Reproduces the record's SF bit for bit (Tier 2 at h 0.2, same platform).
Colour scale tops at the read-out peak (1.0-10.0 mm from the point); stresses at the loaded patch run above it.
TET10 solid, 76440 tets, 361665 DOF · first 14.0 mm of the point, tilted 50° about the bisector · deformation ×20
